fun_facts: Brenton Strange is from Parkersburg, West Virginia.
Brenton Strange was a four-star recruit who left West Virginia to attend Penn State after a standout career at Parkersburg High School.
As a true freshman at Penn State, Brenton Strange started all nine games, caught 36 passes for 489 yards and six touchdowns, and returned five kickoffs for 100 yards.
In 2022, Brenton Strange caught 32 passes for 362 yards and five touchdowns and earned third-team All-Big Ten honors.
Brenton Strange finished his Penn State career with 70 catches, 755 receiving yards and 11 touchdowns in 37 games, including 31 starts.
